#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const long long mod = 998244353;

struct JS {
    static const int BS = 1 << 16;
    static const char NC = 0;
    char buf[BS];
    int bId = 0, size = 0;
    char c = NC;
    double num = 1;
    std::istream& in;

    JS() : in(std::cin) {}

    char nextChar() {
        while (bId == size) {
            try {
                size = in.readsome(buf, BS);
            } catch (...) {
                return NC;
            }
            if (size == -1) return NC;
            bId = 0;
        }
        return buf[bId++];
    }

    int nextInt() {
        return (int)nextLong();
    }

    long long nextLong() {
        num = 1;
        bool neg = false;
        if (c == NC) c = nextChar();
        for (; (c < '0' || c > '9'); c = nextChar()) {
            if (c == '-') neg = true;
        }
        long long res = 0;
        for (; c >= '0' && c <= '9'; c = nextChar()) {
            res = (res << 3) + (res << 1) + c - '0';
            num *= 10;
        }
        return neg ? -res : res;
    }

    double nextDouble() {
        double cur = nextLong();
        return c != '.' ? cur : cur + nextLong() / num;
    }

    string next() {
        string res;
        while (c <= 32) c = nextChar();
        while (c > 32) {
            res.push_back(c);
            c = nextChar();
        }
        return res;
    }

    string nextLine() {
        string res;
        while (c <= 32) c = nextChar();
        while (c != '\n') {
            res.push_back(c);
            c = nextChar();
        }
        return res;
    }

    bool hasNext() {
        if (c > 32) return true;
        while (true) {
            c = nextChar();
            if (c == NC) return false;
            else if (c > 32) return true;
        }
    }
};

vector<vector<long long>> matMult(const vector<vector<long long>>& a, const vector<vector<long long>>& b) {
    int n = a.size();
    int m = b[0].size();
    int k = a[0].size();
    vector<vector<long long>> res(n, vector<long long>(m, 0));
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
            for (int l = 0; l < k; l++) {
                res[i][j] += (a[i][l] % mod) * (b[l][j] % mod);
                res[i][j] %= mod;
            }
        }
    }
    return res;
}

vector<vector<long long>> matPow(vector<vector<long long>> a, long long p) {
    int n = a.size();
    vector<vector<long long>> res(n, vector<long long>(n, 0));
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) res[i][i] = 1;
    while (p > 0) {
        if (p & 1) res = matMult(res, a);
        a = matMult(a, a);
        p >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    JS scan;
    long long n = scan.nextLong();
    long long m = scan.nextLong();
    long long L = scan.nextLong();
    long long R = scan.nextLong();

    long long h = R - L;
    long long e = 0, o = 0;
    if (h % 2 == 1) {
        long long d = (h + 1) / 2;
        e = d;
        o = d;
    } else {
        long long d = h / 2;
        e = d;
        o = d;
        if (L % 2 == 1) o++;
        else e++;
    }

    vector<vector<long long>> mat = {{e, o}, {o, e}};
    vector<vector<long long>> pphard = matPow(mat, n * m);
    long long ans = pphard[0][0];
    if ((n * m) % 2 == 1) ans += pphard[0][1];
    cout << ans % mod << "\n";

    return 0;
}
